dataset_refs: eight fresh unexposed public development identities admitted by sealed scoreability
experiment_template.research_question: Does one bounded completion-readiness projection after a receipt-confirmed candidate effect and verification observation improve GLM-5.3-flash useful-context completion at 8K while reducing or preserving cumulative tokens?
stop_conditions: Any unbounded unknown usage, retry, asymmetric score, integrity failure, or cost-cap violation stops before the next task.

records.falsifier: The boundary cannot be proven, fewer than six pairs are eligible, treatment aggregate tokens exceed control, any quality metric degrades, or macro Span-F1 gain is below 0.05.
records.mechanism: Hold the verification-confirming response without effects, fork exact state, and show treatment observable effect paths, patch identity, verification activity, unresolved status, and admissible pinned-base evidence.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash fresh scoreable 8K ContextBench development tasks at the 96K cumulative input-plus-output tier.
records.statement: A compact completion-readiness projection after a receipt-confirmed candidate effect and verification observation reduces redundant exploration and improves valid useful-context completion.
